# HEM v0.6.2b4 — Fix Reading availability startup crash

Focused recovery release for `AttributeError: 'Reading' object has no attribute 'available'` when initializing HEM with selected room door contacts.

- Add a read-only, computed `Reading.available` property based on finite normalized numeric data. Missing data remains unavailable, never zero. The existing discovery checks still reject stale, restored, implausible and unsupported-unit measurements.
- Fix both the manager startup failure and silently discarded humidity/CO2 evidence in climate planning and door context, which use the same Reading model.
- Keep the Reading constructor, stored dataclass fields, serialization and configuration unchanged. No migration, controller policy, menu layout or Announcement Hub routing change.
- Replace the door-monitor test's invented `available=True` fixtures with production Reading/Room/Window objects. The existing CI gate now exercises the exact failing manager loop, climate CO2 aggregation, normalization, invalid/missing values and model compatibility.

Update through HACS and restart Home Assistant to load the corrected Python model. Do not remove/re-add the integration or reset settings.

The remaining door-feature work is intentionally excluded from this hotfix.
